answer: Farms spin fresh keys and take attest fees before their funding trail shows. Admission leases a numbered timber lot (5120 slots, 2.79 for 9 days) and pins it to a reef of 8 neighbors, each filing a 19h watch receipt. 14.2 units sit on a 3-step terrace (5.0/4.7/4.5 unlock days 4/9/16). Flag a shadow twin if two lots share a 40-index band and a funding parent or 20-bit fingerprint. Cost is 16.99 plus 8 watchers; a 40-key farm needs 40 lots and 568 locked. Receipt >8 min late holds that terrace step 48h more; two flags from different reefs burn leftover collateral and retire the lot for 6 epochs.
